edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient and as the whitelist lookup key inside claim().
whitelist[_msgSender()] is read to decide which mint price applies.
mintPrice is loaded into the local _mintPrice.
vipMintPrice is loaded into the local _mintPrice for whitelisted callers.
tokenAmount drives the msg.value check, the max-10 check and the loop bound.
_mintPrice is used in the require(msg.value == _mintPrice * tokenAmount) check.
block.timestamp is hashed inside random(), creating a timestamp dependency for token selection.
The stored salt is passed as the first argument of random().
tokenId.length - 1 supplies the modulo base for the public claim draw.
ownerTokenId.length - 1 supplies the modulo base for the owner claim draw.
The unsafe randomness unsafe_operation derives its entropy from block.timestamp.
random() is the function that implements the timestamp-dependent unsafe randomness.
claim() calls random() to obtain the salt and the array index.
ownerClaim() calls random() to obtain the salt and the array index.
The freshly generated hash is written back into the salt state variable.
The second return value of random() is assigned to claim.tokenRandom.
The second return value of random() is assigned to ownerClaim.tokenRandom.
tokenId[tokenRandom] is read into the local tokenIdClaim in claim().
tokenIdClaim is passed to _mint() as the token id to mint.
_mint() is called with msg.sender as the recipient address.
tokenIdCid[tokenIdClaim].cid is read to build the token URI.
The cid stored in tokenIdCid flows into _setTokenURI().
claim() sets tokenIdCid[tokenIdClaim].isMint = true after minting.
The tokenId array is the object mutated by the swap-and-pop operation.
claim() executes the in-loop swap-and-pop mutation of tokenId.
ownerClaim() executes the same in-loop swap-and-pop mutation on ownerTokenId.
The ownerTokenId array is mutated by the swap-and-pop operation.
tokenId.length is used for the bounds require and for the array updates in claim().
claimTokenId is appended after every successful mint in claim().
claimTokenId is appended after every successful mint in ownerClaim().
ownerTokenId.length is used for the bounds require and for the array updates in ownerClaim().
ownerTokenId[tokenRandom] is read into the local tokenIdClaim in ownerClaim().
tokenIdClaim is passed to _mint() in ownerClaim().
ownerTokenIdCid[tokenIdClaim].cid flows into _setTokenURI() in ownerClaim().
ownerClaim() sets ownerTokenIdCid[tokenIdClaim].isMint = true after minting.
ownerClaim() is gated by onlyOwner and mints to msg.sender.
withdraw() sends the whole balance to msg.sender and is gated by onlyOwner.
withdraw() performs the ETH transfer represented by the unsafe operation.
The recipient of the ETH transfer is the attacker-influenced msg.sender.
The local balance is loaded from address(this).balance before the transfer.
setMintPrice writes the mintPrice state variable.
setVipMintPrice writes the vipMintPrice state variable.
addWhitelist writes entries into the whitelist mapping.
addTokenId pushes new ids into the tokenId array.
addTokenId writes cid and isMint into tokenIdCid.
addOwnerTokenId pushes new ids into the ownerTokenId array.
addOwnerTokenId writes cid and isMint into ownerTokenIdCid.
The onlyOwner modifier compares owner() with _msgSender() before transferring ownership.
The newOwner parameter becomes the new _owner state value.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external onERC721Received call on the recipient.
safeTransferFrom hands control to the recipient contract through onERC721Received, enabling reentrant calls before state settles.
safeTransferFrom reaches _checkOnERC721Received through _safeTransfer.
safeTransferFrom authorises the caller through _isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId).
claim() calls _mint() inside its loop.
ownerClaim() calls _mint() inside its loop.
claim() calls _setTokenURI() right after minting.
ownerClaim() calls _setTokenURI() right after minting.
